page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates on a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, including stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, fall into the bottom 25% tier, with single-threaded gzip compression dropping to the bottom 10%. Conversely, multi-core performance is consistently average, placing in the middle 50% for stress-ng multi-core, Passmark CPU, and Geekbench multi-core tests. Memory bandwidth for both cached and uncached reads and writes also aligns with mid-tier expectations.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.sn2.3xlarge is its lower single-threaded efficiency, making it less suitable for serialized execution tasks. However, its dedicated CPU allocation and multi-threaded capacity support stable performance for parallelized workloads. It is suited for general-purpose applications such as static web serving, Redis database operations, software compilation, and moderate multi-threaded data processing.
